summary: Old Dominion Freight Line filed an 8-K covering routine annual meeting results (Item 5.07) and a quarterly dividend declaration (Item 8.01). No special-situation event—acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change—is present. The filing is a standard current report on shareholder votes and a regular cash dividend.
